label: Bible Study
prompt: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy _____.
verse: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
note: Jesus to faithful Philadelphia — hold on, so no one takes your crown.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have _____ each other.
verse: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
note: Mercy and truth meet, righteousness and peace kiss — the Bible's sweetest reunion of virtues.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The _____ of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.
verse: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.
note: God's promise to the widow: the barrel of meal won't run out and the oil won't fail until the rain comes.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I _____ to the God of heaven.
verse: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.
note: Nehemiah's arrow prayer: between the king's question and his answer, a silent word to heaven.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the _____ plant of a strange vine unto me?
verse: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
note: God planted 'a noble vine, wholly a right seed' — how did it turn into the 'degenerate plant of a strange vine'?
